reconciliation.placeholder_cols_added: Contig id/Start/Stop/Strand (protein-only mode lacks nucleotide coords)
reconciliation.skip_reason: hAMRonization by-design skips Type=VIRULENCE rows (AMR-focused tool; not a loss bug)

contract: output records = input records (per tool); original files untouched
contract_note: Cross-tool ID formats differ by design: AMRFinderPlus outputs short protein IDs (e.g. 'Sample<N>|k127_103006_2'), RGI outputs full prodigal descriptions (e.g. 'Sample<N>|k127_74392_3 # 1519 # 2016 # 1 # ID=30_3;...'). The hamronized tables preserve each tool's native ID; no cross-tool ID mapping is attempted (that would require a separate identity mapping contract). AMRFinderPlus protein-only mode: Contig id/Start/Stop/Strand are placeholder values (0/0/0/+) — documented, NOT real coordinates.
confidence_levels: RGI includes Loose hits (--include_loose in 24_bac_card.sh:86); AMRFinderPlus includes all types except VIRULENCE (designed skip). Cross-tool confidence comparison requires filtering to matching levels (e.g. RGI Perfect/Strict vs AMRFinderPlus Exact) — NOT provided by format harmonization alone.
